text: What happens inside your body in just one second? You replace about three point eight million cells. Every second. That's about three hundred and thirty billion cells a day, roughly one percent of you. Most of them are blood cells, and cells lining your gut, which wear out in days. Meanwhile, your heart beats about once a second, without you ever asking it to. So you're quietly rebuilding yourself, every single day. Follow for more weird facts about your body.
